listing.name: Animal Crossing: New Horizons (ACNHRecomp)
listing.summary: Build Animal Crossing: New Horizons locally from your own Switch game and 3.0.2 update. The project reports reaching the island and walking around on Ubuntu Linux. Saving and a full day of play remain unconfirmed, and online play is unavailable.

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Use your own base NSP and 3.0.2 update NSP for title 01006F8002326000, plus prod.keys. The project recommends title.keys and accepts optional owned DLC. Its guide requires no separate firmware folder.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Follow the project’s Linux launcher or shell setup. It imports the game and builds locally. On Windows the setup requires WSL2, Linux or a Mac. There is no released player or native Windows build pipeline.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The reported Ubuntu x64 test used Iris Xe at 30 FPS. Forcing 60 FPS doubles game speed. Apple silicon scripts are untested and Android is unsupported.
